pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometry with low-frequency, smooth pixel gradients at the edges, resulting in rounded vertices. These regions occupy a significantly larger relative spatial area than the surrounding light-colored pathways.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of narrow, light-colored pathways with high continuity. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent, forming a consistent topological graph across the visible flank and lower neck areas.
